## User problem

Who needs this, what are they trying to do, and what currently gets in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe a small example, including the expected result. Note existing alternatives or workarounds.

## Acceptance checks

What observable behavior would show that the feature works?

## Constraints and evidence

Mention relevant locale, PHP/cPanel, accessibility, privacy or integration constraints. Separate observed evidence from assumptions; do not invent demand, traffic, provider capabilities or pricing.

Use synthetic examples. Do not attach credentials, private catalogs, backups or personal data. This request does not authorize paid services, CI or deployment.
